blocks.question: A patient wants to cancel tomorrow morning's appointment. Do we charge a fee?
blocks.answer: It depends on the notice. If the patient is cancelling at least 24 hours before the appointment, it is not a late cancellation and no fee applies. With less than 24 hours' notice it is recorded as a late cancellation and a fee may be charged, as listed in the fee schedule at reception. The first late cancellation in any 12-month period is waived, so check the patient's history before charging.

citations.title: Cancellation notice
citations.quote: Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice are recorded as late cancellations.

citations.title: Waiving the fee
citations.quote: The first late cancellation in any 12-month period is waived.

items.text: The question does not say the appointment time or when the patient called. Check whether there is at least 24 hours' notice.
The fee amount is not in the handbook. It is listed in the fee schedule at reception.
